title: Dental PPO Plans Allowance Rule for Reprocessed New-Plan-Wait Lines
content:
The allowance a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a denial for the new waiting period that followed a change to a plan covering its service class (a reprocessed new-plan-wait line) is figured on follows the billed procedure, and so decides the patient share.

**Condition, judgement, result.**
- *Condition:* a posterior composite filling on a plan with the posterior composite alternate benefit, or a porcelain or ceramic crown (CDT D2740, D2750, D2751, D2752 or D2783) on a molar (teeth 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 30, 31 and 32) on a plan with the molar crown alternate benefit. *Judgement:* is the billed amount not below the alternate allowance? *Result:* yes, the alternate allowance; no, the billed amount.
- *Condition:* any other line. *Judgement:* is the billed amount below the allowed amount? *Result:* yes, the billed amount; no, the allowed amount.

**Plans with the alternate benefits.** Posterior composite: Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250 and Plus 1500. Molar crown: Classic 1250 and Plus 1500. Neither: Premier 2000 and Elite 2500.

**Hypothetical.** A crown D2752 on tooth 19 on Classic 1250 billed 990.00 with an alternate allowance of 744.90 is figured on 744.90; the same crown on tooth 12 (not a molar), with an allowed amount of 861.25, is figured on 861.25.
